C5.note: PRIMARY: YOLO11n + AVIF encode of EVERY P1 candidate (needed to know exact bits); desktop CPU proxy, 1 thread

C3.rule: T1 - max(T0, T0+) > 0 in macro AND micro F1, and precision drop <= 0.05

C4.note: T2/T2v are GT-assisted suppression heuristics, not upper bounds: a non-positive difference does not show that cooperative headroom is absent

criteria.C5_note: primary = all candidates encoded; p90 reported in screening.C5

config.status: EXPLORATORY: EXPL split only, not a confirmation

closed.hold: full-dataset hash rule, not in the mirror

smoke_expl.purpose: pipeline check on real frames; no criterion read

config.budget_rule: B = {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} x mean per-epoch stream (strong tokens + every P1 crop at q35, both UAVs, headers) + one level fitting two full frames
config.tuning: alpha in {0.3..0.7}, tau_decl in {0.05..0.5} chosen per (condition, q, B) on the same sequences; declared
